name: wavnil
description: Wavnil social media automation. Schedule posts, manage integrations, upload media, and track analytics across 28+ platforms including X, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

wavnil.note: Official Wavnil MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection — the agent is prompted to sign in to Wavnil; no token or local install required. Lets the agent manage your social media posts
